slides.text:
**Myth: your coding agent only sends what you typed.**

Claude Code put users' emails in the User-Agent header of web requests.

The account email sat in the model's context all along.

panel.small: tool calls that sent one user's email

slides.text:
My rule: anything in the agent's context is something it can send.

**Fair warning or overblown? Pick a side, then save this.**
bullets: Subagents ran curl with an email, a name or even a repo in the header.
The Claude Code team is removing the email from the model's context.
Counterpoint: it mostly hit sites like the SEC, which require an email.
